savings.label: Estimated representative time saved
savings.note: Compared with the assumed time needed to handle the same work without AI.

savings.label: Estimated value of time saved
savings.note: Estimated time saved multiplied by the assumed representative hourly cost.

savings.label: Estimated AI investigation cost
savings.note: Estimated AI model and image-processing costs. Excludes claim reimbursements and representative time.

savings.label: Estimated net savings
savings.note: Estimated value of time saved minus estimated AI investigation costs. Excludes claim reimbursements and other operating costs.

assumptions.label: Assumed representative hourly cost
assumptions.description: Assumed fully loaded cost of one support representative hour, including employment costs. The dashboard multiplies estimated hours saved by this rate. PROVISIONAL — this estimate was set by this project, not supplied by ShipBob.

assumptions.label: Estimated AI cost per investigated product
assumptions.description: Estimated AI model and image-processing cost for one investigated product. Claims stopped by eligibility checks do not incur this cost. PROVISIONAL — this estimate was set by this project, not supplied by ShipBob.

assumptions.label: Assumed manual time per investigated product
assumptions.description: Assumed time for a representative to investigate one damaged product without AI assistance. Estimated time saved is this amount minus the recorded review time. PROVISIONAL — the manual process has not been timed.

assumptions.label: Assumed manual time per stopped claim
assumptions.description: Assumed time for a representative to identify and close an ineligible claim without the automated checks. PROVISIONAL — the manual process has not been timed.

data.title: Recommendations accepted without changes, by week
data.summary: Representatives accepted 67% of AI-investigated product recommendations and 79% of eligibility-check decisions without changes.

data.title: How representatives handled AI recommendations
data.summary: Of investigated products, 67% were accepted without changes, 14% had only the merchant email wording changed, 11% had the recommended outcome or reimbursement changed, and 8% were sent back for another investigation.

data.title: AI confidence compared with representative acceptance
data.summary: Each bar shows the percentage of recommendations accepted without changes. The shaded range shows the AI confidence for that group. When a bar falls below its shaded range, actual acceptance was lower than the stated confidence.

data.summary: Representatives spent an average of 8.4 min reviewing each decision during this period.

data.title: Potential automation rules
data.caveat: A candidate rule is only worth discussing if representatives agreed with the system at least 95% of the time across at least 200 decisions. Both numbers are ours and neither has been agreed with anyone. Meeting the bar is not permission: FR-2.9 says a person approving is the only way a claim can be released, and no figure on this screen changes that. PROVISIONAL.
